The complaints accuse Gandhi of using inappropriate and disrespectful language towards Amit Shah. He is required to submit a response to the Secretariat by August 28, after which the Speaker will assess both the complaints and his reply.

He mentioned an argument with his wife, Padmavathi, before his death.  Padmavathi's family has accused her husband of murder and subsequent suicide.  Police are investigating the circumstances surrounding their deaths.

title: 'I shot him': Luigi Mangione pleads guilty to killing United Healthcare CEO
description: Luigi Mangione has confessed to the fatal shooting of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson in Manhattan. He has entered a guilty plea for federal stalking charges in connection to the incident. This plea addresses one of two criminal cases targeting Mangione, while he is still preparing for a state murder trial set for September. During the investigation, authorities found a 3D-printed gun along with a notebook.

Marcus Aurelius' quote on how perception shapes what we hear and see
description: Marcus Aurelius, the philosopher-king of Rome, turned to Stoicism as a means to master the trials of existence. He championed the ability to control one's own reactions, urging acceptance of circumstances beyond personal control. His focus on virtue over fleeting fame, wealth, or power is vividly captured in his reflections, Meditations, which continue to provide valuable insights for overcoming life's challenges and uncertainties.

title: Brunei Sultan strips daughter-in-law of royal title over 'unbecoming conduct'
description: Sultan Hassanal Bolkiah of Brunei has stripped daughter-in-law Pengiran Raabi’atul Adawiyyah of her royal title over conduct deemed “unbecoming” of a royal spouse. The palace said her actions tarnished the monarchy’s reputation and showed disrespect towards the Sultan. Raabi’atul remains married to Prince Abdul Malik, with no divorce announced, while their four daughters retain their titles.

title: Male redback spiders somersault directly towards a female’s fangs during mating
description: Recent research uncovers that a singular genetic region governs the intricate somersaulting behavior of male redback spiders during mating rituals. This fascinating behavior, crucial for reproduction, is inherited through the X chromosome. Experimental hybrids indicate that this somersault characteristic is not only recessive but also X-linked. Conversely, abdominal narrowing seems influenced by a combination of multiple genes and environmental conditions, challenging traditional views on the complexity of genetic traits.

title: Unthinkable crime shatters Indian family in US, raises questions about AI
Pew survey: What US, UK and others think about India at 80
description: India's standing on the global stage reveals a mixed bag of perceptions among nations, with only 45% viewing it favorably. While Pakistan's outlook remains critical, Sri Lanka showcases significant support. Since 2025, favorability has waned in several countries, yet noteworthy improvements have emerged in Germany and the UK, highlighting the complexities and challenges of India's international reputation.

title: Gandhi's letter to India, as told through TOI
description: From his South Africa years to the freedom struggle, Mahatma Gandhi repeatedly used newspapers to address India’s public. Alok Sharma sifts through letters Gandhi wrote to TOI, illuminating his positions on Satyagraha, the Rowlatt Act, Dalit representation, Hindu-Muslim unity and the hardships faced by Indians in South Africa.

title: MacKenzie Scott helped abolish $40B in medical debt; how mechanics work
description: MacKenzie Scott is leading the charge in medical debt relief, having made groundbreaking donations that freed over $40 billion for families burdened by this often overwhelming responsibility. Her innovative approach, which involves acquiring debt at minimal costs for cancellation, has inspired other billionaires to make similar contributions. Yet, the call for broader policy reform lingers, revealing the constraints of this philanthropic model.

However, Amazon has raised concerns, indicating the bill may drive its operations outside of the city.

title: 'India can take risks, hit hard': NSA says message to world clear after Op Sindoor

India conducted precision strikes on terror infrastructure in Pakistan and Pakistan-administered Kashmir.  The operation demonstrated India's military superiority and willingness to act decisively.  This action concluded an 88-hour conflict, forcing Pakistan to seek peace.

title: 'Like coming home': German Ambassador Jasper Wieck recalls 35-year India journey
description: German Ambassador Jasper Wieck reflects on his long-standing friendship with India, illustrated through personal photographs from trips he embarked on nearly thirty-five years ago. These snapshots highlight a simpler era, capturing the essence of India’s monuments and vibrant streets. Each image tells a story of unexpected friendships and everyday moments that remind us that travel memories can often extend beyond mere tourist attractions.

title: Oracle prepares fresh layoffs before September 1, asks managers to name who goes

Some teams face double-digit percentage cuts. The move follows a year in which Oracle eliminated 21,000 jobs, spent $1.8 billion on restructuring, and poured $55.7 billion into AI data centres.
